UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use generic centered layouts or unstyled default HTML elements.
Ensure all buttons have active/hover/focus states with smooth micro-interactions.
Do not use transparent backgrounds for header and dropdowns; use backdrop-blur with tinted solid background.
Include rich pre-loaded mock data representing Mukman Group, SchoolCab, Cabzee, and Mukman Advisory across India operations (Delhi NCR, Bengaluru, Mumbai, Pune).
Implement the 'Enhance with AI' mock feature with convincing prompt variations (Tone: Corporate, Inspiring, High Impact, Concise) and simulated streaming/instant smart rewriting.
Provide Role Switching in the header so evaluators can test Employee, Manager/Approver, and Admin experiences seamlessly.
Ensure Sonner toasts are used for timesheet submits, approvals, penalty adjustments, and WhatsApp reminder dispatches.
